fix(tree): grow skippedNodes when pooled capacity is stale (#4852)

getValue resliced the backtrack stack to index+1 on the assumption that
its capacity equals Engine.maxSections. The pool captures that capacity
at allocation. Routes registered afterwards raise maxSections without
resizing the pooled slice. The next request that needs one more frame
panics inside the router, before Recovery.

append grows the slice when the captured capacity is short and preserves
the existing backtrack behaviour when it is already sufficient. The reset
at entry stays: getValue still runs once per method tree on the same stack.
